scope: Nine actual BaseBoard clock/reset/TTL families including original CLOCKGEN N4:70representative statebits/87actual boardbits. Untouched original processes with local word access. Matched50MHz negative-edge input-stage/positive-edge launch/capture,20ns embedded paths,2nsmax0nsmin virtualIO,no cuts. Includes shell/admin/pruning;not full BaseBoard/global budget or timer calibration.

cell_SN74LS259.scope:
Pinned BaseBoard clock/reset/TTL local state adapters, preserving source processes.

These nine families cover70representative bits and87actual board bits. The
other192remaining board FF bits reuse qualified adapters unchanged. Local
words are18bits, valid only while the caller holds every consumer. No board
handshake/global barrier/timer calibration or physical snapshot is provided.
